name: lwr
description: Companion to the LEAPWare Runway Claude Code plugin, now with the same enforcement: an engine identical to it, an enforcing PreToolUse hook (hooks/hooks.json), and lwr-config/lwr-report skills.

interface.longDescription: lwr makes an AI coding session's spend rules mechanical. Both the Claude Code and Codex plugins enforce via a PreToolUse hook backed by the same lwr_core policy engine, with lwr-config and lwr-report skills for inspecting and previewing policy.
interface.defaultPrompt: lwr: show the current token policy and report on the last action.
